create_message_in_channel: create a message in a channel with content, reply_to_id, and parent_id using MessageTable.insert_new_message
get_message_by_id: get a message by its id including thread replies, reactions, and user info via MessageTable.get_message_by_id
search_messages_by_channel_ids: search messages across multiple channels by content string with optional timestamp range using MessageTable.search_messages_by_channel_ids
add_reaction_to_message: add an emoji reaction to a message by id, user_id, and reaction name using MessageTable.add_reaction_to_message
get_messages_by_channel_id: get paginated top-level messages from a channel ordered by creation time using MessageTable.get_messages_by_channel_id
